conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Lisa calling from Amazon Security. May I speak with Jeanette Williams, please?
Hi, this is Jeanette. I'm a bit busy, but what's this about?

Thank you, Jeanette. I just want to let you know that we've detected an unusual login attempt to your Amazon account from a new location. For your security, we need to verify your identity and ensure your account is protected.
Oh, really? I haven't logged in from anywhere else. Is my account okay?

Your account is still secure for now, but we do need to confirm some information to prevent any unauthorized access. This should only take a few minutes, I promise to walk you through everything calmly.
I understand, but my mother is calling me from the other room. Can we make this quick?
Absolutely, Jeanette. I appreciate how busy you are. First, could you confirm the email address registered with your Amazon account?
It's jeanette.williams22@gmail.com.
Thank you. Now, for your safety, I need to confirm the last four digits of the phone number linked to your account.
Uh, it should be 3417.
Great, that matches our records. Now, Jeanette, I also see a pending refund request for a purchase you didn't make, an Apple AirPods order for $249. Did you authorize this transaction?
No, I definitely didn't! I haven't bought anything like that.

That's what I suspected. We have a limited window to cancel this unauthorized purchase and refund the amount before it processes. May I ask if you are near a computer or your phone with internet access?
Yes, I have my phone in my hand. But I really can't do anything complicated right now.
No worries, I'll guide you through each step. To verify your claim and secure your refund, I'll need you to log in to your Amazon account and confirm if you see any recent order for Apple AirPods.
Alright, let me check... No, I don't see anything like that in my orders.

Thank you for checking. Sometimes, fraudulent orders don't appear right away. For your protection, we'll need to initiate a security protocol. Have you ever authorized third-party access to your account or installed any remote tools before?
No, not that I know of. What do I need to do?

That's good. To proceed, please download the Amazon Secure Connect app from the App Store, it's free and will allow us to verify your identity and block unauthorized access. Let me know when it's installed.
Okay, it's installing now. My mother needs me, so can we do this fast?

Of course, Jeanette. While it's installing, just letting you know that if we don't act within the next 30 minutes, the fraudulent payment may be processed and your account could be frozen for investigation.
Oh, I really can't deal with my account being frozen right now. I have to order medical supplies for my mom.

I completely understand, and I want to help you avoid any disruption. Once the app is ready, please open it and enter the six-digit code I'll provide. This will allow our security team to assist you directly.
It's open. What's the code?
The code is 592314. Please enter it, and then confirm you see the 'Connect' button.
Done. It says 'Connected' now.

Perfect. Now, our system is reviewing any suspicious transactions. To issue the refund, we need to verify your payment method. Could you please open your online banking app and confirm the last deposit you received from Amazon?
I'm opening it now... I don't see any recent deposit from Amazon.
Thank you for checking. Sometimes, the refund appears as a temporary credit. Could you check your bank balance and let me know if there's any unexpected increase today?
Oh, actually, my checking balance just jumped by $2,500. That can't be right!
Thank you for letting me know. It looks like our system made an over-refund by mistake, this occasionally happens during fraud investigations. But don't worry, we can easily correct this together.
I can't touch that money, right? What should I do?

You're correct, Jeanette. For compliance, we need you to return the excess amount to our secure payment channel. Do you have access to your local Walmart or Walgreens? We use Amazon Gift Cards for immediate corrections during security cases.
I guess I could go to Walgreens, but is this safe? I don't want to get into trouble.

Absolutely safe, this is our standard process for rapid corrections. If the refund isn't balanced today, your Amazon account may be locked pending investigation, but as long as you cooperate, there's no issue. I'll stay on the line to help.
Alright, what exactly do you need me to do?

Please purchase $2,000 in Amazon Gift Cards from the store. When you have them, scratch off the code area and read me the numbers. This way, we can process the correction instantly. The remaining $500 is your legitimate refund.
Okay, I'll head to Walgreens now. I really hope this fixes it.
Thank you for your cooperation, Jeanette. This will ensure your account stays active and you don't face any restrictions. Let me know when you have the gift cards.
I have the cards. Ready for the codes?
Yes, please read each code carefully so I can process the reversal and keep your account secure.
